library_preparation_preflight.summary: The artifact's POM has only two compile dependencies: spring-boot-test-autoconfigure and spring-boot-restclient. Its core feature is MockServerRestClientCustomizer, which wraps spring-test's MockRestServiceServer. spring-test is not a transitive dependency, so the scaffold alone cannot exercise that feature. Boot 4.1.1's BOM pins Spring Framework 7.0.9. The sibling spring-boot-restclient test also had to add spring-boot-http-converter by hand.

deterministic_setup.reason: MockRestServiceServer and MockServerRestClientCustomizer need spring-test, which restclient-test does not pull in. 7.0.9 is the Spring Framework version in the Spring Boot 4.1.1 BOM.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: No Docker image, environment variable or system property is needed. Tests should run in-process with no network. Build a RestClient.Builder, apply MockServerRestClientCustomizer (and the related restclient-test classes), then bind and verify expectations with MockRestServiceServer. Follow the existing spring-boot-restclient test project (tests/src/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-restclient): it adds spring-boot-http-converter 4.1.1 for message conversion and assertj-core 3.22.0, and uses a conditional agent with user-code-filter.json. Add spring-boot-http-converter if JSON or other body conversion is exercised. If the scaffold already resolves spring-test through another dependency, the explicit spring-test entry can be dropped.
